criteria_assessments.Assessment_Finding: Alvaria Cloud qualifies as a current core CCaaS platform, but Alvaria's 2026 corporate GTM is increasingly centered on compliant proactive outreach through AIP. Under locked schema v1.0, CLS-CC-006 is the closest rational class because buyer value is strongest in installed-base modernization/coexistence and outbound-heavy enterprise operations; a distinct outbound/compliance-specialist class is deferred to the Cohort 4 normalization gate.
criteria_assessments.Buyer_Fit_Notes: Fit depends on buyer condition described in finding.

criteria_assessments.Assessment_Finding: Best fit is enterprise and upper-midmarket operations with material outbound, collections, compliance, WEM or existing Aspect/Noble/Alvaria estates. Greenfield buyers seeking the cleanest broad modern CCaaS control plane should explicitly compare the mixed portfolio/control-plane burden.
criteria_assessments.Buyer_Fit_Notes: Fit depends on buyer condition described in finding.

criteria_assessments.Assessment_Finding: Alvaria supports global operations, but public evidence does not justify blanket sovereignty. The GDPR material states global transfers and potential US/India remote access to EEA data; deployment-specific hosting, media, backups, support and subprocessors must be mapped contractually.
criteria_assessments.Buyer_Fit_Notes: Fit depends on buyer condition described in finding.

criteria_assessments.Assessment_Finding: Alvaria Cloud supports VoIP and enterprise contact-center telephony, but current public evidence does not clearly establish the full buyer-specific BYOC/carrier abstraction, number ownership, SIP topology and regional carrier model. Treat telephony breadth as substantive with carrier-flexibility proof required.
criteria_assessments.Buyer_Fit_Notes: Fit depends on buyer condition described in finding.

criteria_assessments.Assessment_Finding: Inbound routing is substantive: Alvaria Cloud documents ACD/universal queuing, IVR, screen pop, real-time monitoring and multi-channel routing. AIP adds campaign/audience/compliance orchestration for proactive engagement.
criteria_assessments.Buyer_Fit_Notes: Fit depends on buyer condition described in finding.

criteria_assessments.Assessment_Finding: Alvaria Cloud documents email, chat and SMS alongside voice. Current evidence supports meaningful digital breadth, but does not establish a single persistent-dialogue control plane across the same breadth as digital-native enterprise suites.
criteria_assessments.Buyer_Fit_Notes: Fit depends on buyer condition described in finding.

criteria_assessments.Assessment_Finding: Outbound/proactive engagement is a defining strength. Alvaria documents automated outbound dialing, callbacks, best-time-to-call, account ownership, compliance-hub controls, campaign orchestration and high-volume human/agentic outreach through AIP.
criteria_assessments.Buyer_Fit_Notes: Fit depends on buyer condition described in finding.

criteria_assessments.Assessment_Finding: WEM depth is substantive and current. Aspect Cloud Workforce covers forecasting, scheduling, tracking, adherence, performance and multi-site functions; Quality and Performance remain supported product families with current 2025/2026 documentation.
criteria_assessments.Buyer_Fit_Notes: Fit depends on buyer condition described in finding.

criteria_assessments.Assessment_Finding: Alvaria provides contact-center reporting/monitoring, workforce data models and separate Engagement Analytics. criteria_assessments.Buyer_Fit_Notes: Fit depends on buyer condition described in finding.

criteria_assessments.Assessment_Finding: Alvaria Cloud has current agent, team-lead and administrator experiences with engagement-center handling for voice/email/chat/SMS and WEM participation. Buyers should map which desktop applies across Cloud, WEM, CRM and AIP workflows.
criteria_assessments.Buyer_Fit_Notes: Fit depends on buyer condition described in finding.

criteria_assessments.Buyer_Fit_Notes: Fit depends on buyer condition described in finding.

criteria_assessments.Buyer_Fit_Notes: Fit depends on buyer condition described in finding.

criteria_assessments.Buyer_Fit_Notes: Fit depends on buyer condition described in finding.

criteria_assessments.Buyer_Fit_Notes: Fit depends on buyer condition described in finding.
